title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Remi Collection Contemporary Bathroom Hardware Allied Brass
description:
Organize your bathroom with the sculptural and modern Remi Collection towel bar or hanging rack. This 30-inch wall-mounted fixture is crafted from solid brass, ensuring long-lasting durability and a premium feel. The contemporary design features a curved accent and upright style that complements both traditional and architectural decor. 

Highlights:
- Solid Brass Construction: Crafted from high-quality brass for corrosion-free and rust-free performance.
- Space-Saving Design: Wall-mounted installation maximizes your bathroom area while providing ample space for hanging towels.
- Seamless Appearance: Concealed screw mounting hardware provides a clean, professional look.
- Designer Finishes: Available in 25 finishes, including statement colors like Unlacquered Brass and Matte Black.

Specifications:
- Width: 30-Inch
- Bar Diameter: 0.75-Inch
- Mounting: Wall Mount
- Material: Solid Brass
- Included: Towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
